# Time w/ Logan 
Date: 2026-08-24 | Duration: Unknown

## Summary
The discussion centered around comparing GrowthBook and Statsig, emphasizing product inspiration and areas for improvement. GrowthBook, drawing from Statsig's polished UI and feature set, faces challenges in onboarding due to technical terminology and manual data setup. Key differences include how feature flags are linked to experiments, with Statsig offering more real-time data monitoring and metric alerts, while GrowthBook seeks to improve these aspects. Participants highlighted the need for clearer guidance and tooltips in the UI to aid non-technical users, as well as proposing enhancements like comments for better collaboration. Overall, the team discussed actionable roadmap priorities to streamline user experiences, automate setups, and enhance experiment analysis capabilities.

## Keywords
experiment setup, feature flags, metrics alerts, user interface, data sources, onboarding

# Time w/ Logan
Date: 2026-08-24 | Duration: 68m

## Summary
The discussion revolved around enhancing user experience through UI simplification and better management of experiment features. Logan Bates and Gabe Melean emphasized the need for inline editing instead of modals, highlighting that distractions from current modal systems hamper user flow. The importance of progressive disclosure for user comprehension was raised, particularly regarding the insufficient in-UI help observed in Growth Book compared to Statsig. Additionally, the differentiation in UI quality was attributed to varying resource allocations, with Statsig benefiting from dedicated design teams. The meeting also explored the complexities of experiment setup, with suggestions to streamline processes. Feedback from Notion was a key driver for prioritizing UI improvements. Overall, there was an acknowledgment of the need for enhanced collaboration among team members and leadership to better align product development with user needs.

## Keywords
experiment setup, UI design, feature flags, metric alerts, product analytics, onboarding

## Action Items

**Johnny Martinez**
Collaborate on incorporating Notion’s feedback and oversee UI improvements for clearer experiment setup and diagnostics (02:09)
Coordinate with Michael Knowlton regarding metric alert feature implementation similar to Statsig’s system (12:55)
Work on UI callouts refinement to reduce frivolous warnings and improve user clarity (31:55)

**Logan Bates**
Provide ongoing support and demos relating to product feedback and comparisons with Statsig to assist onboarding and feature alignment (00:19)
Assist in conceptualizing inline editable UI with client-side caching and batched saves for better UX (49:31)
Offer to review and give feedback on design reviews of large UI projects within GrowthBook (56:24)

**Gabe Melean**
Evaluate feasibility and impact of inline UI editing to reduce modal dependencies (49:07)
Facilitate UI and user experience feedback loop among team members and stakeholders for future releases, working closely with UI/UX engineers (50:31)
